title: Model prices
intro: Nodestro estimates costs with these prices in US dollars per million tokens. Orkexa calculates every cost; the prices are checked against their sources regularly, large changes wait for your review, and individual prices (for example contract prices) win over the reference prices.
unit: US dollars per million tokens. “–”: not known; the cost of that part then stays unknown and is never counted as 0.
staleWarning: The prices have not been checked for more than {{hours}} hours. Costs are still estimated, but may be out of date.
staleCritical: The prices have not been checked for more than {{days}} days. Treat the costs with caution; in strict mode, requests with these prices are refused.
lastError: The last check failed; the last valid prices stay in use:
readOnly: The reference prices of this server are managed by its operator. You can set individual prices for this workspace.

sync.failed: Some sources could not be checked: {{sources}}. The last valid prices stay in use.
sync.manual: Automatic checks are off; prices only change when you check them.

mode.label: Price mode
mode.standardHint: Unknown and stale prices only warn: the request runs, and its cost is shown as unknown or partial.
mode.strictHint: Requests to a model without a known price, or with a price that is out of date, are refused before they are sent.

reviews.intro_one: {{count}} price list waits for your review: some prices changed by more than the threshold without confirmation from an official source.
reviews.intro_other: {{count}} price lists wait for your review: some prices changed by more than the threshold without confirmation from an official source.
reviews.title: Price list {{version}}
reviews.approved: The new prices are in use.
reviews.rejected: The change was rejected; the previous prices stay in use.

override.intro: An individual price, for example a contract price or a correction, applies only here and wins over the reference price. The history keeps every change.
override.unit: In US dollars per million tokens, with a dot as decimal separator (for example 2.5).
override.remove: Back to the reference price of {{model}}

reconciliation.title: Compare with provider bills
reconciliation.intro: Optional: compares Nodestro's estimates with what OpenAI and Anthropic billed, per day and model. It needs an admin key of the provider's billing API, only reads, and warns when the gap is above both thresholds.
reconciliation.providerFailed: The bill of {{provider}} could not be read:
reconciliation.thresholds: Thresholds: more than {{percent}} % and more than {{amount}}.
reconciliation.onceKeys: Admin keys for this comparison only
reconciliation.onceKeysHint: These keys are used for this one comparison and are not stored.

billing.saved: The admin key is stored encrypted.
billing.desktop: The desktop app does not store admin keys. Set NODESTRO_OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY or NODESTRO_ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY, or enter a key for one comparison below.
